summary: Measure internet censorship is a CLI tool that runs OONI Probe to collect data on censorship and network performance worldwide. It is built as a Go binary distributed via direct download, requiring no API key. Researchers and activists needing on‑the‑ground measurements of internet blocking would use it. The project is actively maintained (last commit today) and has a solid community (288 stars, 33 contributors), but it lacks automated integration options and its test suite shows 0 of 3 tests passing, indicating limited ease of use and unknown performance characteristics.
